title: When configuration
description: Canonical schema for the When self-hosted scheduling app's config.yaml.

availabilities.description: List of availability profiles for scheduling.

Auth.title: Auth
Auth.description: Admin authentication strategy. Exactly one of `oidc` or `credentials` must be declared.

oidc.description: Disabled when Credentials auth is active.

AvailabilityProfile.title: AvailabilityProfile
AvailabilityProfile.description: Availability profile for scheduling rules and weekly hours.

id.description: Unique identifier for the availability profile.

slot_granularity.description: Time step in minutes; booking slots will snap to this boundary (default: 15).

minimum_notice.description: Minimum lead time required for bookings in minutes (default: 120).

maximum_lookahead.description: Maximum number of days in the future that are open for booking (default: 60).

buffer_before.description: Minutes of buffer time required before each appointment (default: 0).

buffer_after.description: Minutes of buffer time required after each appointment (default: 0).

max_appointments_per_day.description: Maximum number of appointments allowed in a single day. null means unlimited (default: null).

Branding.title: Branding
Branding.description: Branding options for the booking page and emails. Place custom assets in ./data/public/ to serve them at /public/.

logo_url.description: URL of the logo image. Can be relative (e.g. /public/logo.png).

color.description: Color theme configuration for the booking page.

primary.description: Primary brand colors for light and dark modes.

light.description: Primary brand color for light mode.

dark.description: Primary brand color for dark mode.

avatar_url.description: URL of the avatar image. Can be relative (e.g. /public/avatar.png).

favicon_url.description: URL of the favicon image. Can be relative (e.g. /public/favicon.ico).

page_title.description: Title of the booking page (e.g. "Schedule a time with me").

description.description: Subtext or introduction shown on the booking page.

id.description: Unique identifier for this calendar, referenced by event types.

service_id.description: ID of the caldav or nextcloud service to connect with.

CalDavService.title: CalDavService
CalDavService.description: CalDAV service credentials for generic calendar sync.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service, referenced by calendars.

url.description: Base URL of your CalDAV endpoint (e.g. https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/).

refresh_interval.description: Minutes between the worker's busy-time refreshes for this calendar.

password.description: Admin password. Defaults to the WHEN_ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable.

DatabaseConfig.title: DatabaseConfig
DatabaseConfig.description: On-disk SQLite paths. Relative paths resolve against this config file's directory, so web and worker (which load the same config.yaml) open the same files.

DaySchedule.title: DaySchedule
DaySchedule.description: Array of HH:MM-HH:MM time ranges in the user's timezone.

EventType.title: EventType
EventType.description: Definition of a bookable event type.

id.description: Unique identifier for the event type.

name.description: The name of the event type (e.g. 30-minute chat).

duration.description: Duration of the meeting in minutes.

slug.description: URL slug for the booking page (e.g. "chat" for /schedule/chat).

visibility.description: Visibility on the homepage. "public" shows it; "private" hides it.

appointment_flow.description: The approval flow. "auto" confirms instantly; "requires_confirmation" requires host approval.

conflict_calendars.description: Calendar IDs to check for conflicts (busy times) to block slots.

destination_calendar.description: Calendar ID where confirmed bookings will be written.

availability.description: ID of the availability profile to use for scheduling.

note.description: A note shown to guests after booking.

video_chat.description: ID of the video chat provider to generate dynamic links.

slot_granularity.description: Override for slot granularity in minutes.

minimum_notice.description: Override for minimum notice required in minutes.

maximum_lookahead.description: Override for maximum lookahead in days.

buffer_before.description: Override for buffer before the meeting in minutes.

buffer_after.description: Override for buffer after the meeting in minutes.

max_appointments_per_day.description: Override for maximum appointments per day.

image_url.description: URL of an image representing the event type.

form_fields.description: Custom form fields for the booking process.

FormField.title: FormField
FormField.description: Custom question form fields for bookings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the form field.

type.description: Type of form field (e.g. guest_name, guest_email, event_location, text, number, paragraph, choice).

label.description: The question prompt or label shown to the user.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled in (default: false).

choices.description: List of options for the choice field type.

id.description: Unique identifier for this calendar, referenced by event types.

service_id.description: ID of the google service to connect with.

google_calendar_id.description: The specific Google calendar ID (e.g. primary or an email address).

id.description: Unique identifier for this video chat provider.

type.description: Video chat provider type: must be google-meet.

service_id.description: ID of the google service to use for video chat creation.

GoogleService.title: GoogleService
GoogleService.description: Google API service credentials for calendar and meet integrations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service, referenced by calendars and video chat integrations.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: A static location description for a meeting (e.g. an address, a phone number, or a static meeting link).

NextcloudService.title: NextcloudService
NextcloudService.description: Nextcloud service credentials for CalDAV calendar and Talk video chat integrations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service, referenced by calendars and video chat integrations.

url.description: Base URL of your Nextcloud instance (e.g. https://nextcloud.example.com/).

id.description: Unique identifier for this video chat provider.

type.description: Video chat provider type: must be nextcloud-talk.

service_id.description: ID of the nextcloud service to use for video chat creation.

enabled.description: Whether metrics collection and endpoint are active.

secret.description: Bearer token for scraping metrics. Defaults to METRICS_TOKEN env var.

Smtp.title: Smtp
Smtp.description: SMTP server used to send appointment emails. Required — the appointment system relies on it.

from.description: Email address used as the From on all emails and as the organizer on guest-facing calendar invites, so the host's own address is never exposed. Must be an address your SMTP server is allowed to send from. Defaults to noreply@<your url.app domain>. The display name always comes from user.name.

app.description: Public base URL of the app (include the scheme), used to build links in emails and calendar events.

internal.description: Base URL the worker uses to reach the app over the internal network (e.g. http://when-app:3000), used to fetch relative branding images for embedding in emails. Defaults to the WHEN_URL_INTERNAL env var (baked into the Docker images per target); empty falls back to `app`.

worker.description: Base URL the web app uses to reach the worker over the internal network (e.g. http://when-worker:9000), used to query private worker telemetry and metrics.

name.description: The display name of the schedule owner.

email.description: Email address of the schedule owner.

branding.description: Branding overrides for the schedule owner.

WeeklySchedule.title: WeeklySchedule
WeeklySchedule.description: Weekly schedule specifying available time windows for each day.
